Assumed demand — sell-through model, 12 weeks from the WK39 MOD set

Basis (provided): load-in for almost all launches is 2 cases/store; regular velocity for the set runs 1–1.5 units/store/wk. Stores: 3,264 ±10% (finals early Aug). Load-in is separate from this table: 6,528 cases × units/case ship before WK39; the table models sell-through after set. Note: at 1–1.5 u/st/wk, the load-in alone covers roughly 11–16 weeks of sell-through (at 8 u/case) — first replenishment PO likely lands months after launch, so the initial order IS the volume story.
